biography.background: 5th-generation Texas rancher (RX Ranch, Lampasas County). Secretary, Texas Farmers Union. Founder/President, Texas Progressive Caucus. Program Associate, Trade Justice Education Fund. B.A. International Politics + Mandarin Chinese from Southwestern University. Environmental researcher in China, kindergarten teacher in Taiwan, NSF water researcher.
biography.priorElections: Lost 2020 general for TX State Senate District 24 to Dawn Buckingham (R)
biography.primaryResult: Ran unopposed in Democratic primary March 3, 2026

policyPositions.position: 'Monopolies have rigged the system' — central campaign theme. Four corporations control 60%+ of coffee, cookies, bread, plus meat/seed/dairy concentration. Calls for antitrust enforcement.
200,000+ TX farms are family-owned; 18,000+ disappeared since 2017. Restore viability against corporate consolidation.
Dedicated /stop_ai_centers page. AI data centers consuming 49B gallons TX water in 2025, potentially 399B by 2030. PFAS contamination. Use TDA role in State Water Plan.
Remove harmful chemicals and additives from food; oppose PFAS 'forever chemicals'
Universal free school meals, farm-to-school local sourcing from TX farmers, eliminate processed foods from schools
'No family should drive 90 miles to have a baby.' 25+ rural TX hospitals closed, 76 at risk. Use TDA's State Office of Rural Health.
Opposes neoliberal trade policies; works professionally at Trade Justice Education Fund
2020: explicit Medicaid expansion. 2026: broader 'affordable, timely healthcare for all' framing
2020: wind investment to stop climate crisis. 2026: soil health, water protection, PFAS framing appropriate to TDA scope
Promote clean water, healthy soil, long-term agricultural sustainability
2020: explicitly opposed school privatization. Consistent values.
